audits.method: All 66 snapshot images viewed via 11 locally composed 2×3 contact sheets; selected problematic captures also viewed at original size. Sharp composition was used only for temporary QC sheets; original PNGs, manifest observations, screenshots and feature records were not modified.

contact_sheets.retention: Temporary local QC artifacts; not part of committed feature-map data.

limitations: Only the 66 captures in the explicit manifest snapshot were reviewed. Later screenshots require another QC pass.
Safe QA fixture context is inherited from capture metadata; image inspection cannot independently prove that all underlying data originated from fixtures.
No confidential values visible in fixture screenshots were transcribed into findings; UI control names and feature IDs only.
An empty historical graph is noted as fixture/data-state limitation, not diagnosed as a loading failure.
DOM inspection and screenshot visibility are separate evidence scopes. The original observations remain preserved even when screenshot associations need narrowing.
No browser, Trezor User Env, device, server, account, permission or application setting was controlled for this task.
